body: Hello, this mod is designed to improve the survival aspect of Minecraft. It's an unfinished version that will undergo changes over the coming months, but in its current version, it includes new double and small flowers that beautify the plains and forests. It also features a unique function that allows you to heat milk to obtain many different types of cheese. Finally, it includes knives that are faster than swords but deal slightly less damage, offering new possibilities in the PvP category.
